name: Kahara Mizuki
source: [url=/c83565]Tomoyuki's[/url] younger sister and [url=/c3269]Megumi's[/url] childhood friend. She moved to Tomoyuki's place after a month he moved. She is dishonest and violent toward his brother, though they still get along as they often joke around and come to agreement sometimes.
